meta.title: Learn AI. Build with AI. Create the Future.
meta.description: RoboHolic AI teaches artificial intelligence, coding and robotics to students aged 8 to 18 through real projects, with a Teacher Academy and tools for schools.

hero.eyebrow: AI education for ages 8 to 18, teachers and schools
hero.subtitle: AI education for students, teachers and schools.
hero.lead: Guided lessons, an AI tutor by your side, real projects reviewed by a teacher, and certificates worth showing.

entrances.title: One platform, three ways in
entrances.description: RoboHolic AI is built for the whole classroom: students learn, teachers teach and create, schools run it all.

students.label: Students
students.title: Learn AI through real projects.
students.description: Follow a pathway made for your age, ask Robo AI when you are stuck, build projects and earn XP, badges and certificates.

teachers.label: Teachers
teachers.title: Teach and create with AI.
teachers.description: Run classes, assign official courses, review projects with AI-suggested grading, and create your own lessons.

schools.label: Schools
schools.title: Bring structured AI education to your school.
schools.description: Licences for every class, teacher training, analytics and certificates, all in one place.

pathways.title: A pathway for every age
pathways.description: From the first questions about AI at age 8 to building AI products at 18, each pathway is a sequence of courses that ends with projects to show.

empty.title: Pathways are on their way
empty.description: The learning pathways will appear here as soon as they are published.

robotics.title: Robotics is a main pathway, not an add-on
robotics.description: Students give machines eyes, sensors and decisions: the AI they learn on screen ends up moving in the real world.

courses.title: AI Robotics courses
courses.description: From a first smart robot to autonomous machines that see, sense and decide.

vision.title: Vision and sensor projects
vision.description: Cameras that recognise objects, sensors that react, robots that follow a line or find their way.

challenges.title: Robot challenges
challenges.description: Weekly and school-wide challenges where teams submit what their robot can do.

hardware.title: Simulator first, any hardware next
hardware.description: Lessons start in a simulator and support several robot platforms, so no single brand is required.

teacherAcademy.title: Professional development built for the classroom
teacherAcademy.description: Short, practical courses that help teachers understand AI, use it responsibly and bring it into their own lessons, with a certificate at the end.

points.foundations: AI foundations and prompt engineering for educators
points.lessons: Creating lessons, images and videos with AI
points.assessment: AI for assessment, differentiation and inclusive education

howItWorks.title: Learn. Try. Build. Get feedback. Improve. Show your project.
howItWorks.description: Every course follows the same loop, whatever the age: understanding comes from making, and making gets better with feedback.

learn.title: Learn
learn.description: Short lessons with text, video and examples explain one idea at a time.

try.title: Try
try.description: Hands-on activities and quizzes check the idea before moving on.

build.title: Build
build.description: Every course leads to a project: a story, a model, a chatbot, a robot.

feedback.title: Get feedback
feedback.description: A teacher reviews the project, helped by an AI suggestion, and explains what to improve.

improve.title: Improve
improve.description: Students resubmit a better version and see their progress.

show.title: Show your project
show.description: Finished projects earn XP, badges and certificates that can be verified online.

projectBased.title: Every lesson ends with something you made
projectBased.description: Lessons are not slides to read. Each one walks through the same nine steps, from the first question to the project you keep.

tutor.title: Robo AI, the tutor that guides instead of answering
tutor.description: Explain, hint, quiz me, give an example, challenge me, check my work: six ways to get unstuck without being handed the answer.

review.title: Teacher review with AI-suggested grading
review.description: Projects are graded on creativity, technical quality, understanding and responsible use of AI; the teacher always has the last word.

lab.title: An AI Lab to experiment safely
lab.description: Text, image, voice and vision tools, with limits suited to each age.

schools.title: Structured AI education for your whole school
schools.description: A school account brings every class, teacher and licence together, with the data your leadership team needs.

licences.title: Licences for every class
licences.description: Annual school licences cover official courses and pathways for the seats you need.

classes.title: Classes and rosters, ready in minutes
classes.description: Teachers create classes, add pupils without email addresses and share a class code.

analytics.title: Analytics and certificates
analytics.description: Completion rates, quiz results and issued certificates, school-wide.

privacy.title: Privacy by design
privacy.description: Minimal data about pupils, no public profiles, AI usage boundaries set for each age.

schools.noContact: School accounts are set up by the RoboHolic AI team.

cta.title: Ready to create the future?
cta.description: Create a free account and start your first lesson today.

pathwaysPage.description: Seven pathways, each a sequence of official courses with projects to show. Pick the one that fits your age, or the Teacher Academy.

students.description: Core pathways by age, plus AI Robotics for ages 8 to 18.
